title: Office Supplies & Optimistic Listings
intro: Buy the office. Supply your own expectations.

items.name: New PI Office
items.description: A prestigious business address. The advertisement has been photographed from its most legally defensible angle.
items.benefitText: Your own larger office. Computer and telephone included. Other equipment sold separately.
items.purchaseMessage: Office purchased. Please lower your expectations before entering.

items.name: Case Filing System
items.description: A filing system for solved cases. Alphabetical order costs extra. We have declined.
items.benefitText: Search completed PI cases, contacts, summaries and objectives.
items.purchaseMessage: Files installed. The paperwork now has somewhere to hide.

items.name: Office Printer
items.description: Prints reports, invoices and occasional cries for help. Paper jams are its preferred form of communication.
items.benefitText: Unlock document jobs: up to 2 new jobs per game day, $35 per job, 30 in-game minutes to start.
items.purchaseMessage: Printer installed. It already claims to be out of cyan.

items.name: Desk Notebook
items.description: A dedicated home for promising leads and increasingly aggressive underlining.
items.benefitText: Adds a clickable shortcut to your existing Case Notes. Your notes remain available without this purchase.
items.purchaseMessage: Notebook placed. The pencil has requested anonymity.

items.name: Investigation Board
items.description: Put your theories on the wall. They look more convincing with string.
items.benefitText: Adds a wall shortcut to your existing PI investigation board. Investigations remain available on the computer.
items.purchaseMessage: Board installed. Coincidence has nowhere left to hide.

items.name: Coffee Machine
items.description: Turns expensive beans into a convincing reason to remain at your desk.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. No energy or time bonus.
items.purchaseMessage: Coffee machine installed. Your accountant smells trouble.

items.name: Office Television
items.description: For keeping up with current affairs and avoiding your own.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. Television programmes are not connected in this version.
items.purchaseMessage: Television installed. Productivity is watching nervously.

items.name: Reference Library
items.description: Enough serious-looking books to discourage basic questions.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. No investigation bonus.

items.name: Visitor Chairs
items.description: Comfortable seating for people who insist this will only take a minute.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. Includes both visitor chairs.
items.purchaseMessage: Chairs delivered. Clients have run out of standing excuses.

items.name: Framed Painting
items.description: A subtle statement that the wall was too empty.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. Authenticity not included.
items.purchaseMessage: Painting hung. The wall feels represented.

items.name: Display Artefact
items.description: A decorative conversation piece with reassuringly vague provenance.
items.benefitText: Visual office upgrade. Not evidence and not part of an agency case.
items.purchaseMessage: Artefact displayed. Please keep the receipt.
